name: PR header launch control is the multi-agent AgentPicker, not the old Run Review dropdown
description: Proves AC-1: on the PR detail header the launch control is the L07 AgentPicker (multi-select) that REPLACED RunReviewDropdown. The trigger reuses the 'Run Review' label, so the OLD-vs-NEW distinction is proven by the panel it opens — 'Pick agents to run' + 'Run multi-agent review (N)' + 'Configure agents…' are UNIQUE to the AgentPicker (the retired RunReviewDropdown had no such multi-select panel). The trigger is a React <button> (onClick), so — per e2e/INSIGHTS.md 2026-07-06, coordinate clicks may not reach a React-delegated onClick — it is opened with a native HTMLElement.click() eval. LLM-free: the panel only opens; no run is launched. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (acme/payments-api PR #482).

cmd: (()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>x.textContent.includes('Run Review'));if(!b)throw new Error('Run Review trigger not found');b.scrollIntoView();b.click();})()
